Yubico product images and device identification

app/Resources/*.png are unmodified product images from Yubico Authenticator:
https://github.com/Yubico/yubioath-flutter/tree/main/assets/product-images
The name/form-factor icon mapping is adapted from lib/widgets/product_image.dart.
Copyright (C) 2022 Yubico.
Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. See YUBIOATH-APACHE-2.0.txt.

The Swift device-information parser and product naming in xpc/DeviceDiscovery.swift
adapt the read-only management protocol and naming rules from Yubico's
yubikey-manager (yubikit/management.py and yubikit/support.py):
https://github.com/Yubico/yubikey-manager
The adaptation limits identification to known FIDO2 models and metadata fields;
it does not configure devices. The applicable BSD license follows.
